Missing methods in Relationships class break document processing

#### Description

After recent changes, several methods are missing from the `Relationships` class which causes failures when trying to access related parts or serialize relationships to XML.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document

# This will fail when trying to process relationships
doc = Document()
section = doc.sections[0]

# Trying to iterate inner content fails
list(section.iter_inner_content())
```

The issue also occurs when trying to find parts by relationship type:

```python
# This would fail if you had access to the internal relationships
# rels.part_with_reltype('http://some/reltype')
```

And when trying to serialize relationships:

```python
# This would fail when trying to get XML representation
# rels.xml
```

The missing functionality affects basic document operations like iterating through document content and writing documents to files.
</issue>
